description: Fetch one public web page through a residential IP in the chosen country (optionally a city or US state) and return clean markdown (or text/html), with title, final URL, status, and the product price/currency/availability extracted when present. $0.005 per page (x402, USDC on Base), charged only if the page loads. Public pages only; robots.txt respected; no CAPTCHA solving.

city.description: Optional city for the exit IP, needs country (e.g. berlin). +$0.005.

country.description: Country of the residential exit IP, e.g. de, jp, br (default: any)

format.description: markdown (default, best for reading), text, or raw html

state.description: Optional US state, needs country=us (e.g. texas). +$0.005.

name: fetch_page_from_country
title: Read a web page as it appears from a country
